answer: Each attester cell signs a 14-line sonnet, one line per recent attestation hash. The cell's standing is a pearl: it grows a new layer only when every sonnet line reconciles with on-ledger work. A sybil farm flooding the cell with puppets breaks that reconciliation, since puppet lines have no matching real work, so the pearl's ferrous core oxidizes, the cell is demoted, and its bonds burn. The farm must produce genuinely distinct attestation work for every puppet or lose the whole cell's standing.
